<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FindAJob"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HireDecision" name="Company wants applicant to work for them"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationComplete" name="Probation phase complete"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_NotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies" processRef="Process_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job applications"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplications" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Receipt confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Catch_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Potential job offer"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Catch_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HireDecision" name="Company wants applicant to work for them"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyHireDecision" targetRef="Catch_HireDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationComplete" name="Probation phase complete"
                      sourceRef="Task_CompleteProbation" targetRef="Catch_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyPermanent" targetRef="Catch_Permanent"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyNotPermanent" targetRef="Catch_NotPermanent"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Applicant" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitApplications" name="Submit job applications"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Confirmation" name="Receive application receipt confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Offer" name="Receive potential job offer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewChoice" name="Negotiate a job interview?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate a job interview with the company"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_HireDecision" name="Receive company decision to work together">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_HireDecision" messageRef="Message_HireDecision"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteProbation" name="Complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate the company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReviewAndStatusSplit" name="Continue review and job-status paths"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ReviewVisibilityTimer" name="Wait one year for company review visibility">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_ReviewVisibility">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_PermanentStatus" name="Wait for job permanence outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Permanent" name="Receive notice that the job becomes permanent">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Permanent" messageRef="Message_Permanent"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_NotPermanent" name="Receive notice that the job does not become permanent">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_NotPermanent" messageRef="Message_NotPermanent"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingThreshold" name="Rated the company C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Applicant" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplications" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Catch_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Catch_Confirmation" targetRef="Catch_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Catch_Offer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${negotiateInterview}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!negotiateInterview}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Catch_HireDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Catch_HireDecision" targetRef="Task_CompleteProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProbation" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewAndStatusSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewAndStatusSplit" targetRef="Catch_ReviewVisibilityTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Catch_ReviewVisibilityTimer" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewAndStatusSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="Catch_Permanent" targetRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" sourceRef="Catch_NotPermanent" targetRef="End_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A18" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="Catch_Offer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyRating <= "C"}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A19" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="End_Permanent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyRating > "C"}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Companies" name="Companies" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm receipt of job application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate job application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant" name="Want applicant to work for the company?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoHire" name="No job offer to work for the company"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyHireDecision" name="Tell applicant the company wants them to work for it"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ProbationComplete" name="Wait for probation phase to complete">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProbationComplete" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyAfterProbation" name="Rate applicant and determine job permanence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant after probation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicantRated" name="Applicant rated"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Does the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyPermanent" name="Tell applicant the job becomes permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentNotified" name="Permanent status communicated"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyNotPermanent" name="Tell applicant the job does not become permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotPermanentNotified" name="Non-permanent status communicated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Task_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="End_NoHire">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!wantsApplicant}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_NotifyHireDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsApplicant}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHireDecision" targetRef="Catch_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Catch_ProbationComplete" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyAfterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyAfterProbation" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="End_ApplicantRated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyAfterProbation" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_NotifyPermanent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${jobBecomesPermanent}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_NotifyNotPermanent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!jobBecomesPermanent}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPermanent" targetRef="End_PermanentNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="Task_NotifyNotPermanent" targetRef="End_NotPermanentNotified"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
